tldr: Larder now emails a confirmation when an order becomes paid. A new Notifications app sends it through Postmark after the payment commits, once per order, with retries.
goal: Stop customers from asking whether their order went through, and from paying twice: about 40 support tickets a week.

story.heading: Paying an order now queues its confirmation
story.body: mark_order_paid queues send_order_confirmation with transaction.on_commit. A rolled-back payment queues nothing.

story.heading: Notifications sends through an EmailGateway port
story.body: send_order_confirmation sends through PostmarkGateway, the only adapter. A Celery task retries a GatewayError up to 5 times with backoff.

story.heading: SentEmail guards against a second send
story.body: A unique (order, kind) constraint lets 1 confirmation through per order. Order now stores contact_email, filled for existing orders.

story.heading: 4 requirements, all implemented
story.body: The change modifies 2 requirements of orders and adds 2 to notifications. A task stays open: an admin action to resend.

story.heading: The whole change
story.body: Order management now depends on Notifications, which reads Orders and calls the Email gateway. No dependency breaks a rule.

components.summary: place_order stores the contact email; mark_order_paid queues the confirmation after commit.
New app: sends the order confirmation once through the EmailGateway, from a Celery task with retries.
Order gets contact_email, filled for existing orders from the customer.
New SentEmail records each email per order and kind, with Postmark's message id.
New EmailGateway port and PostmarkGateway adapter; provider failures raise GatewayError.
Installs notifications; new POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN and EMAIL_FROM settings.

decisions.title: Send when the order is paid, not when it is placed
decisions.why: A placed order can still fail to pay. The confirmation tells the customer that the payment went through.
decisions.alternative: Send when the order is placed.

decisions.title: Queue after commit, send from a Celery task
decisions.why: The payment webhook does not wait for Postmark, and a rolled-back payment sends nothing.

decisions.title: A SentEmail row with a unique constraint
decisions.why: A repeated task stops at the constraint. The next emails, such as shipped or refunded, add a kind, not a field on Order.

decisions.title: An EmailGateway port with a Postmark adapter
decisions.why: Postmark's message id answers support questions, and tests use a fake gateway.
decisions.alternative: Django send_mail with an SMTP backend.

decisions.title: Keep a contact email on the order
decisions.why: A later change of the customer's email does not move the confirmation of an old order.
decisions.alternative: Read customer.email when the email goes out.

requirements.note: The design accepts a duplicate when Postmark times out after it accepted the message.
